target.description: What the reminder is about, exactly as written: an event title like 'Zahnarzt' or a subject like 'Wasser trinken'.

when.description: Absolute time phrase exactly as written, e.g. 'morgen um 8 Uhr', 'um 18:00'.

relative.description: Relative offset span exactly as written, e.g. 'drei Stunden vorher', '20 Minuten vor dem Termin'.

person.description: Person name exactly as written when the reminder is for someone else, e.g. 'Lisa'.

query: Erinner mich eine Dreiviertelstunde vor dem Arzttermin.
reasoning: 'eine Dreiviertelstunde' is the relative offset; 'Arzttermin' is the target.
